messages:
Samira: Anyone up for urban foraging + potluck this Sat? Found a wild garlic patch near the old mill. :seedling:
Ben: Count me in! I'll bring kimchi pancakes :yum:
Priya: Ooh love this. What time? I have a sunrise kayak class at 7am but free after 10.
Samira: Thinking 11am meet at the mill bridge? Bring tupperware and a small knife. Also maybe a quick ID guide so we don't eat mystery leaves :grimacing:
Miguel: I'm down but allergic to a surprising amount of herbs. I'll bring onigiri and an EpiPen (just in case). Is the trail wheelchair accessible?
Olivia: There's a paved path from the carpark to the bridge — should be fine for wheels. I can bring extra blankets + reusable plates.
Ben: Also I'll bring a portable speaker and a tiny bluetooth speaker stand. Anyone want coffee beforehand?
Priya: If anyone wants early coffee I'm at Tiny Roaster at 10:15, swing by. Also happy to carpool after kayak if you need a lift.
Samira: @Priya awesome — might grab you for the carpool. Quick question: do we need a permit for a small potluck/forage gathering?
Miguel: I've heard the parks team asks for a small-group notification if it's a planned event >10 people. We're def <10 but good to check.
Samira: I'll ping parks and if needed we'll keep it informal. For safety, please don't eat anything you can't ID. I'll bring a laminated cheat sheet of edible vs lookalikes.
Ben: Meme map (not real maps): http://imgur.com/abcd :joy:
Olivia: Also bringing a folding chair and some cutlery. Who's bringing napkins/hand sanitizer?
Miguel: I got napkins + a small first-aid kit.
Priya: I'll grab sanitizer. Excited! :raised_hands:
Samira: Sweet — final list: Ben (kimchi pancakes + speaker), Priya (coffee + sanitizer), Miguel (onigiri + napkins/first-aid), Olivia (blankets + plates/chair), Samira (forage guide + knives). See you Sat 11am at mill bridge. DM for carpool. :sun_with_face:
